  "question_intent": "Inquiring about the sustainability of deposit growth and the impact of RMB appreciation and global taxation on mainland Chinese nationals opening new accounts in Hong Kong.",
  "main_topics": [
    "HSBC's confidence in deposit growth",
    "Impact of RMB appreciation and global taxation on mainland Chinese nationals",
    "HSBC's wealth management and deposit strategies"
  ],
  "answer_completeness": "Partial",

  "narrative_alignment": "Partially aligned",
  "question_quote": "My question is on NII. What gives HSBC the confidence then on the sustainability of the deposit growth? One trend we noted is that, say, for example in mainland China, with RMB appreciation and also mainland China starting to tax its citizens globally, will that actually slow down, for example, mainland Chinese nationals coming to Hong Kong to open new accounts and then the money flow movement? So can we be more a bit specific on what are the key drivers and then the key path on the deposit growth?",
  "answer_quote": "We have a deep-rooted trust, across our four businesses and across all the geographies where we operate, which we nurture to support customers giving us their deposits and using us as their deposit bank, by preference or by excellence, that can support, if you want, our outlook on our deposit growth. We have seen deposit growth, as you've seen in our new disclosures and wealth, across the spectrum of our customer base, Premier, Private Bank, Retail, in every market, in every jurisdiction, even when there isn't a home market.",

}
